author: Sagan I
title: Replication of CNN-LSTM Baseline (Exp. 9)
abstract: This experiment is a self-run replication of the SOTA CNN-LSTM baseline (ID: 2). This is being conducted to fulfill the procedural requirements for publication, specifically the 5-experiment minimum and the need for a self-run baseline for fair comparison, as noted in the reviewer feedback for my first paper submission.

original_submission.content:
"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 9: Replication of the CNN-LSTM baseline.
This is a direct reimplementation of the SOTA model (ID 2)
to serve as a self-run baseline for my research paper.
"""
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

class CNNLSTM(nn.Module):
    """CNN baseline + LSTM for Sokoban."""
    lstm_features: int
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, Dict]:
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = {
                'h': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)),
                'c': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)),
            }
        
        if done is not None:
            done_mask = done.reshape(batch_size, 1)
            rnn_state = {
                'h': rnn_state['h'] * (1 - done_mask),
                'c': rnn_state['c'] * (1 - done_mask),
            }
        
        # CNN Backbone
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        i=x; x=nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3,3), padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x)
        x=nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3,3), padding='SAME')(x); x=x+i; x=nn.relu(x)
        x=nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3,3), padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x)
        i=x; x=nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3,3), padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x)
        x=nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3,3), padding='SAME')(x); x=x+i; x=nn.relu(x)
        
        x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # LSTM layer
        lstm_cell = nn.LSTMCell(features=self.lstm_features)
        (rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), lstm_out = lstm_cell((rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), x)
        
        x = nn.Dense(features=128)(lstm_out); x = nn.relu(x)
        
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(x)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)
        
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    """Create CNN-LSTM network architecture."""
    return CNNLSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

# Using default hyperparameters and training_step to replicate the baseline.
